scope.description: All initial changed-file diffs, complete 16-article Markdown bodies, and final review-repair deltas read. Complete bodies include titles, deks, source notes, tables, limits, links and related links. Renderer/provenance mechanisms read; no source, admissions, image, or publication edits by reviewer.
scope.sourceCaptureNote: Original captured-source hashes identify the reviewed retrievals. External articles are not republished here; public URLs, reviewed ranges, and scope limits are retained.

resolvedReviewFindings: Grok fallback retained exclusive token-volume cause; all generation paths now state token mix/cache dependence.
AA later frontier explanation omitted ties; weak inequalities plus one strict improvement now agree.
Devin historical cost paragraph inferred unnamed sidekick/configuration cause; now only reports distinct published observations.
Holdout body contained internal editorial narration and overstated falsification; now reports failure to reproduce public-suite improvement.
Opus Intelligence overbroad AA attribution and Opus 5.5-only limit contradicted vendor and previous-generation sections; scopes corrected.
Open-models body misstated component/composite relation, referenced absent Fable 5 rows, and repeated incomplete frontier rule; all corrected.
MiMo dek hardcoded obsolete snapshot/date/comparator; title/dek/SEO now derive from supplied row with absence fallback.
Grok positive frontier and MiMo both frontier branches omitted equality cases; now use consistent dominance condition.
checks: Dan Luu full captured primary text supports separate holdout reasoning and reported experiment sequence; visible component disagreements alone do not establish hidden optimization holdout.

Harness paper defines three comparison families: managed tiers versus same-window T0, planning on/off at T4/128k, full tools/bash at T4/128k. Revised significance captions match the captured methods and tables.
Harness paper explicitly bundles tools, interface instructions, file-state tracking and diagnostics; revised copy matches. Locally served models are priced using OpenRouter list rates.
Reported HarnessTax 97.8 minus 96.7 equals 1.1 percentage points; similar observed values do not establish statistical equivalence. Original dated source numbers not freshly fetched.
Quoted Opus base rates 5 to 4 and 25 to 20 each fall 20 percent; source claim of 40 percent running cost remains separately attributed. No causal inference from total tokens alone.

Pareto condition matches lib/option-space.ts computeParetoSet: other cost <= candidate cost, other score >= candidate score, at least one strict. Display frontier selects one representative of exact coordinate ties.
Stored datasets independently inspected: coding source September 25 and Intelligence source September 23; coding records have Fable 5.1 variants, not Fable 5.
Real-SWE captured public article supports private reproduction limit/sample request and shows newer results; retained historical September 14 tables are explicitly dated.

scoreInterpretation: Conservative scores describe this existing-corpus corrective review, not a claim of complete source re-admission. Factual confidence is 1 where historical primary-source claims were not freshly reverified. Voice integrity is generally 1 because repetition and long limit lists remain in legacy bodies. All totals are >=9 and no dimension is zero.
limitations: Untouched historical quotations, benchmark figures, prices and source metadata were read for coherence but not freshly endorsed, except the explicitly read Dan Luu source.
Targeted harness source read does not freshly verify every trajectory statistic, quotation, or reconstruction in that article.
No fresh product-release qualification for introduction, no fresh sources for Terminal-Bench-Science/small-models, and no complete repository/docs audit.
Markdown corpus was supplied by author and rendered without image/provenance arguments; hashes cover those complete article projections, not final HTML or metadata rendering.
No tests, build, browser, or publication run by reviewer; relied on author focused validation. The integration owner completes review history, revision dates, and final automated and visual checks.
Preserve historical sourceCheckedOn unless the specific claim/source was rechecked. reviewedOn may record this independent AI pass; human review stays null.
